name: Film Freddy
tagline: Learns what you finish and abandon, then picks your next film
description: It pays attention to the movies you actually finish and the ones you bail on, building a picture of your taste instead of trusting ratings alone. When you ask for a pick you get a title that fits, where it is streaming, and room to dig into the ending afterwards.
author: FrankFindsOut
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
